deletion.consequence.profileRemoved: Your profile, photo and bio are removed from Mohalla.
deletion.consequence.postsRemainAnonymis: Your posts and comments stay where they are, shown as “Deleted User”. They are not removed, because other people replied to them.
deletion.consequence.messagesRemainForTh: Messages you sent stay in the other person’s conversation, shown as “Deleted User”.
deletion.consequence.sessionsEndImmediat: You are signed out on every device straight away.
deletion.consequence.restorableForThirty: You can bring your account back by logging in within 30 days. Your followers, following and posts return with it.
deletion.consequence.permanentAfterThirt: After 30 days this cannot be undone.
